description: Paid ($0.005 USDC on Base, x402). Read a web page as markdown as a person sees it, hidden text flagged, with a signed record. Reads a web page as clean markdown, as a person sees it: hidden text and invisible Unicode are kept out of the text and flagged with a prompt-injection verdict. Also reads PDF, Word and Excel files as markdown. Includes an Ed25519-signed record (final URL, time, status, sha256 of body and text) that verifies offline. Charged only for 2xx pages and documents it can read; refused URLs cost nothing.. Charged only if it succeeds. Call once without payment to get the price, then retry with params._meta["x402/payment"].
